raw: # Party alias mappings: raw party/ballot-line label → canonical label.
# Not state-keyed (unlike the other alias files) — party names are national.
# New York runs fusion voting: one candidate is routinely nominated by several
# parties at once and appears on a separate ballot line for each. The NY parser
# stores every line pipe-delimited in candidates.party
# regardless of how NYSBOE spelled either line in a given year.
